meta.name: lcx-report-bug
meta.description: Create a high-signal bug issue or PR in the repo that owns the defect. Use this whenever the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, especially when they need source-backed root cause, reproduction steps, fix guidance, and GitHub routing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动创建带根因分析和复现步骤的缺陷报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在GitHub仓库中提交高质量Bug Issue或修复PR。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically create bug reports with root cause analysis and reproduction steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to file high-signal bug issues or fix PRs in GitHub repos.

howto.what: 当你要报 LazyCodex 或 Codex 的 bug 时,它会查源码与运行时证据定位根因,判断归属仓库,生成含复现步骤和修复建议的英文 GitHub issue(只有 openai/codex 会开 PR),带 lazycodex-generated 标签。
howto.when: 当你要求报告、提交或分流 LazyCodex、Codex 插件、上游 Codex CLI 等 bug 时触发。

say.text: 报一个 LazyCodex 安装器的 bug,帮我定位根因。
say.note: 会查源码证据并生成 issue。

say.text: 这个 Codex CLI 问题能稳定复现,帮我提到正确的仓库。
say.note: 先比较两个源码仓库再决定归属。

say.text: 已有相同的 issue 了,把我的新证据作为评论补上。
say.note: 不新建重复 issue,改为追加评论。

howto.what_en: When you report a LazyCodex or Codex bug, it gathers runtime and source evidence, picks the owning repo, and files an English GitHub issue with repro steps and fix guidance (PRs only on openai/codex), labeled lazycodex-generated.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to report, file, open, or triage a bug in LazyCodex, a Codex plugin, the upstream Codex CLI, and similar surfaces.

say_en.text: File a LazyCodex installer bug and find the root cause.
say_en.note: Investigates sources and opens an issue.

say_en.text: This Codex CLI bug reproduces; file it in the right repo.
A matching issue exists - add my new evidence as a comment.
